en: A colorized historic cityscape showing a dense town with red-tiled roofs and several prominent Ottoman‑style buildings. A slender minaret of a mosque rises near the left-center, and low, traditional houses fill the foreground. In the distance, the city extends up gentle hills and is surrounded by rolling green mountains under a clear sky. At the bottom right is a printed website watermark: 'www.elia.org.gr'. The overall style resembles an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.
